result.summary: Diagnosed both BLOCKERs (ADHOC-TNT-TEST-003, ADHOC-TNT-TEST-004) as CATEGORY E (test-harness bug), not a source/UI bug. Root cause: the navigateSpa helper in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts:171-177 uses history.pushState + synthetic popstate dispatch, which does not deterministically trigger React Router v6.4+ createBrowserRouter to mount the target route. The proven page.goto-based pattern from web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts:74-79 should be adopted. Registered new ISS-0069 in docs/issues/ and updated issue_index.json. No source code changes are required — the AppShell 'Register Tenant' nav entry, the per-component <Navigate> role guards on RegisterTenant/Progress/Result pages, and the worker-user Keycloak realm (TASK_WORKER-only role) are all correct. Optional non-blocking follow-up noted for CODE-DESIGNER: route-level role guard is absent (ProtectedRoute checks auth only, not roles) but this is NOT the root cause.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2) — produce fix design artefact for ISS-0069 covering only the navigateSpa rewrite in web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts (mirror the goto-based pattern from web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts:74-79). Do NOT bundle route-level role-guard changes; punt that to a separate WF-02 if desired.
